_comment: Column allowlist for ui-orphan-audit.mjs, keyed 'table.column'. Every entry MUST cite an ADR, spec, or migration comment as its reason (docs/plans/data-machine-tool-gaps-2026-09-25.md, lane TOOL-GAP-3). Empty by design on this first run: the RW-2/UI-3 case (state_cost_facts) is a RULED build item (operator ruling 2026-09-25, build order step 4, build the producer), not an allowlist candidate, so it is left as a live finding for the coordinator/operator to track through to that build rather than silenced here. DATA-1 (2026-10-11): the state_cost_facts finding was a scanner defect (guardedInsertFn alias not matched), fixed in scripts/verify/lib/ui-orphan-scan.mjs, not an allowlist entry.

region_dimension_coverage.notes.reason: Coordinator ruling 2026-09-29 (lane W2-A): KEEP-allowlist, not a wire item. Migration 109 (free-text notes column for D2/D4/D5 coverage-gap annotations on the Operations matrix), no default. docs/ops/session-log.d/2026-09-28-audit-triage.md finding B flagged this as a zero-writer field; W2-A grepped the whole repo and confirmed no admin surface manages region_dimension_coverage at all (only a read at src/lib/supabase-server.ts feeding the customer-facing Operations matrix). Ruled operator-typed via SQL by design; no admin edit surface will be built for it.

community_group_members.muted.reason: DATA-1 (2026-10-11) [CONFIRMED by reading]: the writer exists but passes a COMPUTED key the field-grain scanner cannot resolve. src/lib/community/member-pref-route.mjs:55 does .from('community_group_members').update({ [field]: validated.value }) and src/app/api/community/groups/[id]/mute/route.ts:25 binds field to 'muted' (the star route binds 'starred'). Migration 029 defines the column (muted boolean not null default false) and its self-only UPDATE policy for starred/muted. A computed-key write is a known blind spot of object-literal key extraction (see extractOpaqueWriteTables); allowlisted rather than loosening the matcher.

sector_contexts.display_name.reason: DATA-1 (2026-10-11) [CONFIRMED by repo-wide grep]: sector_contexts is static reference data (15 rows live at capture, migration 009 header, 2026-04-27) loaded outside the repo before the table was captured into the migration log; migration 368 records it LIVE after the dead-schema census was refuted. No code, script, seed or migration writes it, and the platform takes no customer data (ADR-042), so no producer is owed; src/lib/supabase-server.ts reads it for the sector synopsis labels. Allowlisted as an out-of-band reference table.
